stories.title: Art ‘must not be sacrificed on the altar of corporate profit’, Liberal senator says as AI policy debate rages
stories.summary: Liberal senator Andrew McLachlan has urged the Labor government to consider artificial intelligence's effects on artists and the environment. Arguing that art should not be sacrificed for corporate profit, he said he favours “real forests over virtual ones” as the national AI policy debate continues.

stories.title: OpenAI will embed Apollo researchers to investigate AI subversion
stories.summary: OpenAI will embed six Apollo Research evaluators to examine whether its AI models engage in subversive behaviour. The arrangement is intended to strengthen scrutiny, although restrictions on the researchers' access and public disclosures have raised questions about their independence.

stories.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: the industry will be ‘fine’
stories.summary: OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman acknowledged Jensen Huang's central role in Nvidia and the wider AI boom but said the industry would ultimately be fine without him leading the company. The discussion reflects how heavily the current AI economy depends on Nvidia and Huang's leadership.
